choices.content: The probability of success on each trial
The number of values when a trial fails
The total number of outcomes in the sample space
The number of successes in $n$ independent repeated trials

question.prompt: What does $X$ represent in the binomial distribution $B(n,p)$?

solutions.explanation: $X$ takes the values $0,1,\ldots,n$ and records the number of successes.
solutions.title: Interpret the binomial random variable
